maddeler.e:
نحترب (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِبُ (naḥtaribu) /naħ.ta.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
# نَحْتَرِبَ (naḥtariba) /naħ.ta.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
# نَحْتَرِبْ (naḥtarib) /naħ.ta.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
